scope: HTTP-driven browser console: quick menu click with the bounded auto-hold, then in-menu direction, confirmation and playback inputs with per-pixel frame comparisons
frame_baseline: The rendered menu before any navigation input
conclusions: A quick menu click opens the original menu through the bounded hold without a manual long press
Two down inputs move the highlight two items; one up input moves it back one item (the standing frame difference matches the single-down state)
Left on the first tab and confirmation on the tab page leave the frame unchanged; right switches the tab
The menu application stays foreground after all inputs
limitations: Frame differences are compared against the pre-navigation menu frame, not between consecutive clicks
The menu reopen boundary documented in the research notes still applies
Screenshots remain in the local run directory and are not published
